0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-3, 7th in the East) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-2, 8th in the West) for Toronto's eighth game of the season, with the Raptors having lost their last two and Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation, 19.5 points per game this season), Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) all out. Denver, riding a two-game winning streak, is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and the Nuggets are 1-1 at home while the Raptors are 1-2 on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Toronto lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026.
